title: dmri_train
description: DMRI training tool for processing diffusion MRI data in FreeSurfer

slist.description: Text file with list of training subject directories
slist.title: Subject list file

trk_files.description: Name(s) of input .trk file(s), one per path
trk_files.title: Input .trk files

rois.description: Optional, names of input tract labeling ROIs, two per path
rois.title: Tract labeling ROI files

cmask.description: Name of input cortex mask volume
cmask.title: Cortex mask volume

lmask.description: Add a label ID from aparc+aseg to cortex mask, one per path
lmask.title: Label ID for cortex mask

outtrk.description: Name(s) of output, pre-sorted .trk file(s), one per path
outtrk.title: Output pre-sorted .trk files

bmask_test.description: Input brain mask volume(s) for test subject
bmask_test.title: Brain mask volumes for test subject

fa.description: Input FA volume(s) for test subject
fa.title: FA volumes

reg.description: Affine registration from atlas to base space
reg.title: Affine registration

regnl.description: Nonlinear registration from atlas to base space
regnl.title: Nonlinear registration

basereg.description: Affine registration(s) from base to FA volume(s)
basereg.title: Base to FA affine registration

ncpts.description: Number of control points for initial spline
ncpts.title: Control points for initial spline

max_streamlines.description: Maximum number of training streamlines to keep per path
max_streamlines.title: Max training streamlines

trunc.description: Use all training streamlines, truncated or not
trunc.title: Use truncated streamlines

out_files.description: Base name(s) of output(s) for test subject, one per path
out_files.title: Output base names

cptdir.description: Output directory for control points in test subject's space
cptdir.title: Control points output directory

checkopts.description: Don't run anything, just check options and exit
checkopts.title: Check options

help.description: Print out information on how to use this program
help.title: Help
